MY.ev_ret: Snapshot · year-to-date (2026-01-01 to 2026-09-30) · data as of 2026-10-01. Anchor: each claim; a player 'redeposited' = ≥1 deposit in the 30 days after claim; matured = the claim had a full 30-day window. Benchmark for the decision = the player's own TIER × bonus-type redeposit norm (not the pillar+type average shown as the (+N) in the row). Observational (vs the code's own / tier-matched players) — not a controlled test; causes are hypotheses. Matches the report's default year-to-date window; a different selected window may differ.
MY.ev_vip: Snapshot · year-to-date (2026-01-01 to 2026-09-30) · data as of 2026-10-01. NGR lift = 7-day window vs a 14-day baseline, NET of the bonus (break-even 0). Observational — not a controlled test; causes are hypotheses. Matches the report's default year-to-date window; a different selected window may differ.

10PERCENTUNLIMITEDBONUS.title: Return and value investigation
10PERCENTUNLIMITEDBONUS.finding: Targeting issue. Profitable (2.65 per RM1) but redepositing is BELOW the deposit bonus tier norm (-6.1pp; 80.3% vs 86.4%) — the offer is not the reason they return. One-player-heavy: 38% of the net revenue is from a single player; without them it is 1.62 back per RM1 — read the rest, not the headline.
10PERCENTUNLIMITEDBONUS.who: Mostly Diamond-tier · deposit bonus · 2198 players matured to 30 days (2333 claimers, 2310 matured to 7 days).
10PERCENTUNLIMITEDBONUS.next: Tighten eligibility to exclude players who would redeposit anyway; A/B against a no-offer control; read redeposit uplift + NGR/RM1 + cost.
diag: one-player-heavy: 38% of net revenue from a single player
